evidence.description: Surveillance showed a black Dodge Durango and a Hyundai Elantra, both with Texas registrations, were present during the burglary
evidence.provenance: Whatcom News citing the probable cause affidavit

evidence.description: GPS trackers placed on the cars under a warrant showed them traveling to Anacortes at the same time the home was burglarized
evidence.provenance: My Bellingham Now citing court documents

evidence.description: Luxury watches and jewelry worth more than 4,000 dollars were stolen
evidence.provenance: Whatcom News citing the probable cause affidavit

items_taken: jewelry worth more than 4,000 dollars together with the watches
notes: The two vehicles were tracked to an apartment complex in Bellingham, where a search recovered bags with jewelry, designer handbags and cash. Both outlets cite a probable cause affidavit filed in Whatcom County Superior Court on 23 Feb 2026; neither links a police release.
